package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRepository interface {
	GetByStudentKey(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error)
	GetDiagnosticByID(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error)
	GetLatest(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error)
	Insert(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error)
}

type DiagnosticBootstrapRepository interface {
	GetLatestDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, error)
	GetDiagnosticBootstrapReceipt(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapReceipt, error)
	InsertDiagnosticBootstrapReceipt(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticBootstrapReceipt) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapReceipt, error)
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRepository persists only Student's safe
// command receipt so an Issuer can prove delivery without storing attempt state.
type DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRepository interface {
	GetDiagnosticReservation(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRecord, error)
	InsertDiagnosticReservation(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRecord) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRecord, error)
}

// DiagnosticPlacementRepository is a separate immutable decision receipt. It
// intentionally has no API for updates, mastery, paths, or task state.
type DiagnosticPlacementRepository interface {
	GetDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error)
	InsertDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error)
}
